body:
Part of General UI Polish (feature item 2). The base styles cap text areas: `textarea{width:min(95%,700px)}` and `input{width:min(80%,600px)}` in `solace_task` (shared base CSS) and in `solace_board` styles, so editors do not fill their panels.

- Change the defaults so a text area fills its container: `width:100%` with `box-sizing:border-box`, no percentage cap; inputs the same.
- Keep the composer in `solace_task.editor_styles` (already `width:100%`) consistent with the new default, and drop per-page overrides that fight it (`solace_board`, `strategy`, `settings` styles).
- The plan panel composer, the board editor, the Strategy new-task form, and the task-detail composer all end up flush with their panels.

**Tests:** view tests that assert the width caps are updated; the build stays green.
title: ui: Textareas fill container width
